label: Order
caption: GREG ABBOTT, GOVERNOR OF TEXAS, ET AL. V. LEAGUE OF UNITED LATIN AMERICAN CITIZENS, ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, IT IS ORDERED that the November 18, 2025 order of the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas, case No. 3:21-cv-259 is hereby administratively stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Monday, November 24, 2025, by 5 p.m. (EST).
